task: Restyle the docs-ssh landing page (public/index.html) to a utilitarian, McMaster-Carr-style ethos. Current style is a dark 'Dracula-ish' theme with purple accents, rounded cards, and generous padding - replace it. Target style: (1) information density over whitespace - tight spacing (4/8/12px scale), compact line-height, no hero padding (main padding-top must be <= 32px); (2) neutral gray palette (dark scheme is fine, keep meta color-scheme) + AT MOST one accent color used sparingly for links/interactive affordances - kill the multi-color purple/green/cyan/peach palette on UI chrome; muted syntax-highlight colors inside <pre> terminal blocks may stay, but ALL text outside <pre> must be neutral grays plus at most ONE shared accent hue; (3) sharp corners - every border-radius <= 6px, no 12px rounded cards; (4) flat surfaces - no box-shadows anywhere, no gradients anywhere; (5) tables for tabular data (token-efficiency table already is one - keep it dense: small uppercase header, tabular-nums); the sources grids may stay grids since they are discovery lists, but make them dense and flat; (6) no animation beyond the existing reduced-motion-gated 0.2s fade; (7) system font stack for prose, monospace for code/terminal/numbers; (8) copy stays spec-like: nouns + numbers + states, no marketing prose (existing copy is mostly fine - tighten, don't rewrite meaning). HARD CONSTRAINTS - do not break these: the literal strings __SOURCE_COUNT__, __VERSION__, __HOST__, __PORT__ must remain in the file verbatim (build-time sed substitution); the <script> block fetching /_sources.json and the version fallback must remain functionally identical; the <pre> terminal command blocks and their ssh command text must keep working; keep it a single self-contained HTML file with inline <style>, no external assets.

sensors.name: placeholders
sensors.cmd: for p in __SOURCE_COUNT__ __VERSION__ __HOST__ __PORT__; do grep -q "$p" public/index.html || { echo "MISSING placeholder: $p (build-time sed substitution in Dockerfile will break)"; exit 1; }; done && grep -q '/_sources.json' public/index.html || { echo 'MISSING /_sources.json fetch'; exit 1; }
sensors.hint: The Dockerfile runs sed -i s/__HOST__/.../ etc on this file at image build time. Restore the exact placeholder tokens and the /_sources.json fetch script.

sensors.name: dom
sensors.cmd: (python3 -m http.server 8977 -d public >/dev/null 2>&1 & SP=$!; sleep 1; browser-assert http://localhost:8977 --wait 'main' --viewport 1280x800 --assert 'document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth' --assert 'document.querySelector("h1").getBoundingClientRect().height > 0' --assert 'document.querySelectorAll("table").length >= 1' --assert 'document.querySelectorAll("pre").length >= 3' --assert 'parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector("main")).paddingTop) <= 32' --assert '[...document.querySelectorAll("*")].every(e => parseFloat(getComputedStyle(e).borderTopLeftRadius) <= 6)' --assert '[...document.querySelectorAll("*")].every(e => getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow === "none")' --assert '[...document.querySelectorAll("*")].every(e => !getComputedStyle(e).backgroundImage.includes("gradient"))' --assert '(() => { const v = new Set(); document.querySelectorAll("body *").forEach(e => { if (e.closest("pre")) return; const c = (getComputedStyle(e).color.match(/\d+/g) || []).map(Number); if (c.length === 3 && Math.max(...c) - Math.min(...c) > 60) v.add(c.join(",")); }); return v.size <= 1; })()' --assert '!document.querySelector(".error")'; RC=$?; kill $SP; exit $RC)
sensors.hint: Fix the failing DOM assertion: no horizontal overflow; h1 renders; >=1 table, 3+ pre blocks; main padding-top <= 32px (density); every border-radius <= 6px (sharp corners); no box-shadows anywhere; no gradients anywhere; at most ONE vivid/saturated text color outside <pre> blocks (single-accent ethos - all other text neutral grays).

sensors.name: ux
sensors.cmd: (python3 -m http.server 8977 -d public >/dev/null 2>&1 & SP=$!; sleep 1; bun ~/.pi/agent/skills/self-correcting-loop/judge.ts --url http://localhost:8977 --wait 'main' --full-page --viewport 1280x800 --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 --spec 'Judge this landing page against a utilitarian, McMaster-Carr-style design ethos. PASS criteria: (1) information-dense layout with tight spacing, no hero-sized padding or giant whitespace; (2) neutral gray palette (dark scheme OK) with at most ONE accent color on UI chrome (links/affordances) - fail if multiple vivid accent colors (purple AND teal AND cyan etc) are used across headings/borders/chrome; muted syntax colors inside terminal/code blocks are acceptable; (3) sharp corners (small radii), flat surfaces, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no heavy drop shadows; (4) tabular data in dense tables; (5) system/monospace typography, code and terminal blocks clearly styled; (6) no horizontal overflow, no overlapping elements, nothing clipped; (7) copy is spec-like, no marketing fluff. EXPECTED and NOT failures: literal tokens like __HOST__, __PORT__, __VERSION__ are build-time substitutions; the sources sections may show a fallback line because /_sources.json is not served locally. Judge only visual style and layout against the ethos.'; RC=$?; kill $SP; exit $RC)
sensors.hint: Address the vision judge's FAIL reasons - they reference the utilitarian ethos: density, neutral palette + single accent, sharp corners, flat surfaces, dense tables.
